page.overview:
What is Flamethrower?

Flamethrowers were weapons that fired streams or bursts of fire.

A millennia-old infantry mainstay, flamethrowers were modernized by Mandalorian super commandos and Republic-era clone troopers during the Clone Wars.

Mandalorian warriors often integrated flamethrowers into their vambraces as one of their many anti-Jedi tools, as the flames could not be blocked by the single beam of a lightsaber, forcing the defender to either retreat. A Force wielder with sufficient skill, strength in the Force and time to react could shield themselves from the flames with the Force, though this required considerable effort. Mandalorian plasma shields could also be used to defend against flamethrower attacks.

At the Boonta Eve Classic, Sebulba equipped his podracer with flamethrowers. He use them as weapon against other podracers to help him win the the podrace. Bounty hunters such as Jango Fett and Cad Bane used flamethrowers against the Jedi.
